image_description: A white minibus (likely a Fiat Ducato or similar chassis) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle is shown from a front-three-quarter angle, displaying the driver's side. It features a high roof, a row of tinted passenger windows, a sliding door track visible below the windows, and standard steel wheels. There is a blue logo/text on the front fender and a small blue square marker on the rear pillar.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from low-profile cars and significantly shorter than full-size transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is clearly visible, along with a continuous row of dark/tinted rectangular windows running along the side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A door seam and handle are visible in the front-mid section, indicating the entrance.
The vertical seam and the horizontal rail/track visible beneath the window line are characteristic of a sliding door mechanism common in this vehicle class.
The short hood/nose section ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout typical of this van-based minibus design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the rear wheel arch; the back of the vehicle is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a black lower trim strip and some blue branding/logos on the front fender.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is a standard steel rim with a hubcap, proportional to the vehicle's size.
The length and window configuration suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, fitting the 'minibus' definition.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The blue text/logo on the front fender is illegible and appears smeared or nonsensical, a common AI artifact where text generation fails to resolve into clear characters.
The side mirror lacks sharp definition and distinct mechanical parts (adjustment knobs, seams), appearing slightly melted or overly smooth compared to the rest of the body.
The door handle is indistinct and blends slightly into the door panel, lacking the crisp protrusion expected of a physical handle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' taxonomy rather than a standard cargo van or full-size bus.
To verify the cylindrical consistency of the wheels and the planar rigidity of the side panels, checking for subtle warping or melting.
To audit the sharpness of the window edges against the body and ensure the sliding door track is topologically connected correctly.
To analyze the illegible blue text on the fender and determine if it is gibberish or just low-resolution compression.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any low-level noise or blur artifacts.
